text: Strategic Directions for 2024 to 2030 have been developed with input and guidance from Board and Committee advisors, community stakeholders, and Toronto Atmospheric Fund staff. The strategy considers internal and external factors that influence our work, Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s strengths and unique capacities, and needs for achieving ambitious climate targets in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA).

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the proposed Strategic Directions (2024 - 2030) as set out in Attachment 1 to the report (April 12, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund.
